info.title: Public API Directory API: OpenAPI Specs by Keyword
info.description:
Search 2,500 public APIs from the APIs.guru directory by keyword or category: OpenAPI version, JSON and YAML spec links, logo and provider contact.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/public-api-directory (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Scrape APIs.guru public API directory metadata: API names, descriptions, versions, OpenAPI URLs and provider links. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Word or phrase matched in the API's name, title and description (case-insensitive), for example payments, weather or stripe.com. Leave empty with categories set to list a whole category.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Keep only APIs in one of these APIs.guru categories: cloud, media, open_data, analytics, developer_tools, ecommerce, financial, messaging, entertainment, telecom, text, location, collaboration, payment, transport, hosting, security, iot, social, tools, marketing, email, enterprise, machine_learning, search.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of rows to return. A request returns 20 rows at most.

201.description: The results, one object per row.
